newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-MONICA SELES'S FATHER HAS CANCER AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-MONICA SELES'S FATHER HAS CANCER AGAIN.

text.p: Karolj Seles, father and coach of tennis star Monica Seles, has had a recurrence of stomach cancer and began chemotherapy last month at the Mayo Clinic, the family said Tuesday.

The 63-year-old Seles was found to have a recurrence of a rare gastric tumour, diagnosed as leiomyosarcoma, during a regular follow-up exam after diagnoses of prostate cancer in June, 1993, and gastric malignancy in December, 1993.

He had undergone treatment and surgery for both tumours, and his health seemed to be improving before the most recent finding. The prostate cancer has not recurred. Examinations in 1994, 1995 and 1996 found no cancer, Monica Seles's spokeswoman said in a statement.
The family said no other details of his treatment or prognosis would be made public.

The initial cancer diagnosis was made within days of his daughter's stabbing during a tournament in Hamburg in April, 1993. The tennis player's recovery and treatment coincided with her father's over the next 2 1/2 years.
She returned to the WTA Tour in the summer of 1995 but missed much of 1996 with shoulder problems. She missed the 1997 Australian Open, which she won four times, because of a broken finger.
